milestone: M4 — intelligent execution + adaptive position management + L1 microstructure
reuse_not_duplicate: Reuses OrderManager, native RiskEngine, CandidateRouter, exposure gate, SimulatedBroker, DecisionEventSink, CapitalReservationLedger, ReplacementCoordinator (M3), order_flow_engine (microstructure). No parallel execution authority.
lifecycle: StrategyRecommendation -> PortfolioRecommendation -> CapitalReservation -> ExecutionPlan -> RiskAuthorization (native) -> OrderIntent -> Broker -> PartialFill/CompleteFill -> BrokerReconciliation -> ExecutionOutcome (TCA). Every transition carries a stable decision id.
tick_scale_fix: Unified the whole system on DEFAULT_PRICE_SCALE (10_000): AlpacaExecutionVenue price conversion + _fmt_usd now match market-data + native-risk ticks, fixing a pre-existing cents(100)-vs-10000 mismatch that M4 limit prices would otherwise have mis-serialized.
safety: Independent -0.5% protective exit preserved + re-verified (never deferred/vetoed by planner/microstructure). New execution policies + profit-protection default non-live (maturity/authorization gated). No live orders.
verdict: Implementation-complete + mock-certified. NOT economically validated / paper / live.
